maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue is new custom-engineered switchgear and power control rooms for projects; service, parts and retrofits are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and gas, petrochemical, utility and industrial firms, not government agencies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through engineered electrical systems and services since 1947, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Custom switchgear and power control rooms are built into customers' plants; safety and downtime make switching costly.
